about: Package fields (exercises.json, muscles.json) to the shipped schema (shared/specialization/types.ts; supabase/migrations/20261016120000_specialization_atlas_schema.sql). 'none' = we have no equivalent.

muscle_ids.rule: One to one by anatomical name, all 19 (regions/forearm/ids.ts:13-33). Package ids are the kebab-case mesh ids of the owner's 3D viewer (02-design.md:207), which 02-design.md:208 already plans as node aliases.
ours_only: forearm.anconeus (adjacent, nodes.ts:258; package: outside scope, START-HERE §4.1)
upper_arm.biceps, upper_arm.brachialis (external contributors with real mappings, ids.ts:52-55; package lists them as free text in external_contributors)

bucket_to_category.direct_dynamic: relationship direct + mode dynamic -> direct_dynamic. Same.
bucket_to_category.supporting_dynamic: relationship contributing + mode dynamic -> contributing_dynamic ('Other dynamic', rules.ts:75). Same meaning.
bucket_to_category.deliberate_isometric: relationship direct (or contributing) + mode isometric + variant.deliberateHold -> deliberate_isometric. Same. Ours requires the variant to be a hold (types.ts:325); the package marks it per muscle.
bucket_to_category.supporting_isometric: relationship stabilizer + mode isometric -> incidental_isometric. Our CATEGORY merges it with incidental grip ('Incidental grip / stabilization', rules.ts:77); the RELATIONSHIP keeps them apart. The package keeps two buckets and START-HERE §8 maps supporting_dynamic+supporting_isometric to one 'supportingExerciseExposure' union.
bucket_to_category.unmodeled: no mapping row. Our 'unknown' category is different: a mapping that exists whose relationship or mode is unknown (rules.ts:29). A muscle with no reviewed mapping anywhere is hatched (02-design.md:62); one with mappings but none in this exercise is simply not touched.
ours_without_package_equivalent: mixed: one bout loads a node two ways, counted once (rules.ts:28, 31). The package's engine allows one bucket per muscle per exercise, so a Zottman-like two-way load has no home there.
contributing isometric in a non-hold variant (78, 80 towel pull-up/rope climb grip) -> incidental_isometric with relationship contributing

grade_to_relationship.3 + supporting_dynamic: contributing (only BR in rows and the towel pull-up, fa-28, fa-29, fa-42)
where_vocabularies_do_not_line_up: The grade is an ordinal magnitude; we have none. Grade 3 vs 2 (BR in rows vs PL in wrist curls) has no counterpart: both are 'contributing'. In this seed the grade adds no information beyond the bucket: 7 (grade, bucket, contraction) combinations cover all 1083 cells (4/DD/dyn 65, 4/DI/iso 19, 3/SD/dyn 3, 2/SD/dyn 33, 2/SI/iso 186, 2/IG/iso 87, null 690).

The package has no 'allocation'. Ours marks FDS+FDP (and other cooperating pairs) 'shared': the work is real but not split (types.ts:370-371); the package scores each muscle independently ('multiple muscles may each score 100'), which is our 'individual' by default.

The package's contraction 'isometric' on an incidental grip and ours agree; but the package also gives FDS/FDP 'dynamic' supporting work in wrist curls (fingers assist wrist flexion) where ours gives an isometric incidental grip (mappings.ts:175).
plausible_grade_band, tissue_exposure_grade_0_4, targeting_index_0_100: no equivalent and none should be added (the package forbids presenting them as statistics or medical scores).

exercise_fields.id (fa-*): none; provenance only. Our identity is the catalog id -> variant cat-<id> (02-design.md:24).
exercise_fields.name: catalog_exercises name (exerciseCatalog*.ts); checked against variant.catalogName by test (variants/forearm.ts:35).
exercise_fields.profile_id: roughly variant.organization + catalog movement (wrist_flex -> single_joint 'Wrist flexion', grip_hold -> task, grip_compound/row -> multi_joint). No 1:1 field.
exercise_fields.publication_status (draft_mapping / bloc: mapping reviewStatus draft|reviewed|rejected (types.ts:22) per mapping, not per exercise; blocked_protocol ~ an unmapped catalog row with a reason (regions/forearm/unmapped.ts); alias ~ no field (same catalog id) or variant.replaces (types.ts:307-311).
exercise_fields.canonical_alias_of: none needed for fa-22 (resolves to catalog 411).
exercise_fields.setup_definition: variant.notes plus its dimensions (organization, forearmOrientation, wristPosition, gripType, straps, laterality, phase, measure, deliberateHold, elbowAngleDeg) (types.ts:306-335).
exercise_fields.evidence_basis (exercise level): per mapping evidenceBasis anatomy|biomechanics|emg|longitudinal|inference|unknown (types.ts:344). Package value 'anatomy_inference_with_analog_studies' -> ours 'anatomy' or 'inference' per cell; every package cell says 'heuristic_anatomical_mapping_not_measured_percentage'.
exercise_fields.source_ids: mapping.sources[] = {sourceId, locator, limitation} (types.ts:346-351). The package gives no locator or limitation per cell; our publication rule needs them (02-design.md:152).
exercise_fields.external_contributors: external node mappings (upper_arm.biceps/brachialis) where real; 'intrinsic hand muscles' is never credited by either (mappings.ts:24-26).
exercise_fields.context_flags: thick_handle, towel_handle, lever_arm_required, phase_dependent, unstable_object, ballistic, catch, pinch, surface_friction, closed_chain, finger_support, extended_wrist, device_specific_resistance, unquantified_resistance: partly gripType (crush/pinch), elbowAngleDeg, phase; thick handle, friction, ballistic, closed chain have no dimension. Descriptive dimensions can be added by the variants lane (variants/dimensions.ts header).
exercise_fields.required_context: side (logger, sidedBy), grip_orientation (variant), straps (logger), parent_bout_id (bout id; drop set stages are segments), actual_reps_or_seconds (reps or holdSeconds), effort (SetEffort). All exist (02-design.md:84-89; deviceWorkoutLog.ts:193).
exercise_fields.prescription_profile_id / prescription_a: none in the atlas. App-wide rep anchors are client/src/lib/trainingEvidence.ts.

mapping_cell_fields.contraction: muscleMode dynamic|isometric|mixed|unknown (types.ts:343); dynamic_concentric_eccentric -> dynamic; unmodeled -> no row
mapping_cell_fields.confidence (low/unresolved): none; reviewStatus + evidenceBasis + rationale carry it
missing on the package side: actionId (which joint action the muscle performs in this exercise; required, every mapping names one of its node's actions, 05-mappings.md:278)
requiresNoStraps (the package withholds the WHOLE bout when grip_assisted; ours withholds only the bare-hand grip mappings, 02-design.md:58)

muscle_fields.physical_function: function claims (regions/forearm/claims.ts) + node actions (nodeActions.ts). Agree for 15 muscles; the package adds assist actions we do not list: BR 'assists return toward neutral rotation', APL 'assists extension at CMC', EPB 'assists CMC extension', EPL 'assists MCP/CMC extension' (we have EPL MCP assist, nodeActions.ts; no thumb CMC extension action id, actions/ids.ts:24-27).
muscle_fields.tissue_units, regional_groups, attachmen: none (no tissue model). New data with new anatomy claims to review if Tendon exposure is built.

event_fields (reference_engine.aggregate.segment_id: segment id (drop-set stage; standard set = one segment)
event_fields (reference_engine.aggregate.exercise_id: catalogExerciseId (name match fallback for old sessions, 02-design.md:34)
event_fields (reference_engine.aggregate.side left/right/bilateral: left/right/bilateral/unknown; unknown kept apart, never an error (02-design.md:52)
event_fields (reference_engine.aggregate.is_warmup: set.warmup; excluded and counted as excluded (exposure.ts:616); package keeps warm-ups as tendon-context exposure
event_fields (reference_engine.aggregate.load_convention: per catalog id (shared/loadConventions.ts:28, 55), not per set
